h2. Description

*The card's More actions menu should show an outline icon before each item.* On staging the item has no icon.

For example,
* the menu opens below the button, lined up with its right edge, which is right
* Reassign lead technician is its only item
* there is no outline icon before the item

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10046*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Board View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
# Rest the pointer on any card and click the three-dot *More actions* button at its top right.
#* The menu shows *Reassign lead technician* with no icon before it.
# Press *Escape*.

*Actual Result:*
* The menu item has no icon.

*Expected Result:*
* An outline icon before each item, as the test expects: *"Step 4: a white menu opens below the button, lined up with the button's right edge, with Reassign lead technician as its first item and an outline icon before each item, as in the menu design picture."*
